data.title: Brazil loses 3-2 to Japan despite Vinicius brace with red cards for Ancelotti and Raphinha - FOX Sports
data.content: # Brazil loses 3-2 to Japan despite Vinicius brace with red cards for Ancelotti and Raphinha. SINGAPORE (AP) — Two spectacular goals from Vinicius Jr. weren't enough to prevent Brazil from losing 3-2 to Japan in a feisty international friendly in Singapore on Saturday that ended with red cards for Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti and Raphinha. Brazil eliminated Japan in the round of 32 at the World Cup in June, and Japan appeared intent on revenge by racing into an early two-goal lead. Tatsuhiro Sakamoto won the match for Japan in the first minute of injury time with the Coventry player pouncing on a loose ball and scoring from close range.
